instruction_en: Walk straight through the doorway into the living room, passing a sofa and coffee table on your left and a television on your right. Turn right to go through the next doorway. Continue straight into the bedroom, with a television on your left, and stop in front of the bed and window.
instruction_zh: 直走穿过门口进入客厅，经过左侧的沙发和茶几，以及右侧的电视。右转穿过下一个门口。继续直走进入卧室，让电视位于你的左侧，在床和窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Walk forward through the doorway, then walk straight, passing a bathroom entrance on your left. Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a white curio cabinet on your left and a white armchair and sofa on your right. Turn left to enter the dining room, then walk straight through it with a dining table and chairs on your left. Stop in front of the doorway leading to the kitchen.
instruction_zh: 向前穿过门口，然后直走，经过左侧的浴室入口。右转进入走廊。沿走廊直走，经过左侧的白色陈列柜，以及右侧的白色扶手椅和沙发。左转进入餐厅，然后直穿餐厅，让餐桌和椅子位于你的左侧。在通往厨房的门口前停下。

instruction_en: Turn left to enter the bedroom, passing a TV on your left and a bed on your right. Stop in front of the vanity table with a mirror on your left.
instruction_zh: 左转进入卧室，经过左侧的电视和右侧的床。在左侧带镜子的梳妆台前停下。

instruction_en: Walk straight forward to enter the living room, passing a couch on your left and a TV console on your right. Turn right to face two doorways. Then, turn left to go through the doorway on your left, entering a bedroom. Walk straight forward through the bedroom, keeping the TV on your left and the bed on your right, and stop in front of the window at the far end of the room.
instruction_zh: 向前直走进入客厅，经过左侧的沙发和右侧的电视柜。右转，面向两个门口。然后左转，穿过左边的门口进入卧室。向前直穿卧室，让电视位于你的左侧、床位于你的右侧，在房间远端的窗户前停下。

instruction_en: From the hallway, turn right to enter the room. Walk straight forward with the TV on your left and the bed on your right, and stop in front of the window with the blue and pink curtains.
instruction_zh: 从走廊右转进入房间。向前直走，让电视位于你的左侧、床位于你的右侧，在挂着蓝色和粉色窗帘的窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Walk straight down the hallway, passing an open living area with a couch and a lamp on your right. Continue forward, then turn right to enter a bedroom with a TV on a cabinet on your right. Walk further into the room, towards the window with pink and blue curtains, and stop to the left of the bed.
instruction_zh: 沿走廊直走，经过右侧带有沙发和灯的开放起居区。继续向前，然后右转进入卧室，右侧的柜子上放着一台电视。继续向房间里面走，朝挂着粉色和蓝色窗帘的窗户前进，在床的左侧停下。

instruction_en: Walk forward, keeping the wall with the TV on your left and the living room with a couch on your right. Continue straight, passing a decorative screen on your left, towards the dining room ahead. When you reach the opening, turn left into the hallway. Walk straight ahead, past the painting on your right, and enter the bedroom. Proceed forward into the bedroom, keeping the TV on your left, and stop in front of the bed, with the nightstand to its right.
instruction_zh: 向前走，让装有电视的墙位于你的左侧、带沙发的客厅位于你的右侧。继续直走，经过左侧的装饰屏风，朝前方的餐厅前进。到达开口处时，左转进入走廊。向前直走，经过右侧的画，进入卧室。继续向卧室里面走，让电视位于你的左侧，在床前停下，床头柜位于床的右侧。

instruction_en: Walk forward in the hallway, passing a painting on your left. Continue straight, passing a doorway to a kitchen on your right. At the end of the hallway, turn right to enter the living room. Walk straight through the living room, passing the large grey sofa on your left and a coffee table in front of you, and stop in front of the window.
instruction_zh: 沿走廊向前走，经过左侧的画。继续直走，经过右侧通往厨房的门口。在走廊尽头右转进入客厅。直穿客厅，经过左侧的大灰色沙发和前方的茶几，在窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Walk forward through the doorway, leaving the shower on your left. Turn left into the hallway, passing the white closets on your right. Walk straight down the hallway, then enter the large room at the end. Continue straight, moving past a dining table on your left and a sitting area on your right. Turn left into the kitchen, keeping the grey door with the red stripe on your right. Walk straight through the kitchen, with counters and cabinets on both sides, and stop in front of the window.
instruction_zh: 向前穿过门口，让淋浴区位于你的左侧。左转进入走廊，经过右侧的白色壁橱。沿走廊直走，进入尽头的大房间。继续直走，经过左侧的餐桌和右侧的休息区。左转进入厨房，让带红色条纹的灰色门位于你的右侧。直穿厨房，经过两侧的台面和橱柜，在窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Turn right to enter the bedroom, then immediately turn left and walk straight down the hallway. Continue straight through the open living area, passing a dining table on your left and a bed on your right. Turn left, then walk forward past the grey door with the red line on your right. Turn left to enter the kitchen, then walk straight through the kitchen, passing counters on both sides, and stop in front of the window at the end.
instruction_zh: 右转进入卧室，然后立即左转，沿走廊直走。继续直穿开放起居区，经过左侧的餐桌和右侧的床。左转，然后向前走，经过右侧带红线的灰色门。左转进入厨房，然后直穿厨房，经过两侧的台面，在尽头的窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Turn right, passing a white wardrobe on your left, then enter the hallway ahead. Walk straight down the hallway, passing open doorways on both sides. Enter the large room at the end of the hallway. Turn left, keeping a dining table with chairs on your right, and stop in front of the dark door on the wall ahead.
instruction_zh: 右转，经过左侧的白色衣柜，然后进入前方的走廊。沿走廊直走，经过两侧敞开的门口。进入走廊尽头的大房间。左转，让配有椅子的餐桌位于你的右侧，在前方墙上的深色门前停下。

instruction_en: Go through the doorway and enter the room with white cabinets on your left. Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing an opening on your left and another on your right. Enter the large open room at the end of the hallway, then turn right. Walk past the dining table on your left, and continue forward to stop in front of the large TV screen.
instruction_zh: 穿过门口进入房间，让白色柜子位于你的左侧。右转进入走廊。沿走廊直走，经过左侧和右侧各一个开口。进入走廊尽头的大型开放房间，然后右转。经过左侧的餐桌，继续向前，在大电视屏幕前停下。

instruction_en: Walk forward, keeping the tall built-in shelf with bottles and books on your left. Proceed straight, passing the shelf on your left. Turn right, moving past the dining table on your right. Enter the kitchen through the open doorway on your right. Stop in front of the window and sink, with the large refrigerator on your left.
instruction_zh: 向前走，让摆放着瓶子和书的高嵌入式置物架位于你的左侧。继续直走，经过左侧的置物架。右转，经过右侧的餐桌。穿过右侧敞开的门口进入厨房。在窗户和水槽前停下，大冰箱位于你的左侧。

instruction_en: Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bedroom doorway on your right. Continue forward, passing a study area on your left. As you pass shelves on your left, turn right into the dining room. Walk towards the dining table, keeping it on your left side. Then, turn right and enter the kitchen. Proceed straight into the kitchen and stop in front of the sink, directly under the window.
instruction_zh: 沿走廊直走，经过右侧的卧室门口。继续向前，经过左侧的书房区域。经过左侧的置物架时，右转进入餐厅。朝餐桌走去，让餐桌位于你的左侧。然后右转进入厨房。直走进入厨房，在窗户正下方的水槽前停下。

instruction_en: Turn right, passing the TV and media console on your right. Walk forward through the doorway into the next room. Continue straight, passing a brown chair on your right and a potted plant on your left, and stop in front of the window.
instruction_zh: 右转，经过右侧的电视和电视柜。向前穿过门口进入下一个房间。继续直走，经过右侧的棕色椅子和左侧的盆栽，在窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Walk straight down the hallway. Pass a round mirror on your left and then turn right to enter the living room area. Walk forward with an illuminated panel on your right and a sofa on your left. Turn left into the open doorway beside the TV. Continue straight, passing an open bathroom on your right. Stop in front of the TV, with the bed on your right and a window in front of you.
instruction_zh: 沿走廊直走。经过左侧的圆镜，然后右转进入客厅区域。向前走，让发光面板位于你的右侧、沙发位于你的左侧。左转进入电视旁敞开的门口。继续直走，经过右侧敞开的浴室。在电视前停下，床位于你的右侧，窗户位于你的前方。

instruction_en: Turn left to enter the hallway from the room with the wardrobe. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your right and an open doorway to a bedroom on your left. Go through the open archway at the end of the hallway to enter the living room. Walk forward, passing a sofa and TV on your left, towards the open doorway on your left. Enter the sunroom through this doorway, and turn left. Stop in front of the sofa in the living room, with the large windows on your right.
instruction_zh: 从带衣柜的房间左转进入走廊。沿走廊直走，经过右侧的浴室和左侧通往卧室的敞开门口。穿过走廊尽头敞开的拱形门洞进入客厅。向前走，经过左侧的沙发和电视，朝左侧敞开的门口前进。穿过这个门口进入阳光房，然后左转。在客厅的沙发前停下，大窗户位于你的右侧。

instruction_en: Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your right and a framed picture on your left, as the floor transitions from wood to dark grey tiles. Continue straight past a bedroom entrance on your left. At the end of the hallway, turn right to enter the living room area, with a sofa and TV on your left and dining chairs on your right. Walk forward, passing a white door on your right. Stop in front of the coffee table and sofa, facing the large window.
instruction_zh: 沿走廊直走，经过右侧的浴室和左侧的装框图片，脚下的地面从木地板变为深灰色瓷砖。继续直走，经过左侧的卧室入口。在走廊尽头右转进入客厅区域，沙发和电视位于你的左侧，餐椅位于你的右侧。向前走，经过右侧的白色门。在茶几和沙发前停下，面向大窗户。

instruction_en: Turn right, moving away from the console table with the black and gold painting. Walk straight into the hallway, keeping the wall with two framed plant pictures on your left and a storage unit on your right. Continue straight past an open doorway leading to a bathroom on your right. Turn left through the next doorway to enter the bedroom. Walk forward, keeping the TV and dresser on your left and the bed on your right. Stop in front of the window.
instruction_zh: 右转，远离摆着黑金色画作的边柜。直走进入走廊，让挂着两幅装框植物图片的墙位于你的左侧、储物柜位于你的右侧。继续直走，经过右侧通往浴室的敞开门口。左转穿过下一个门口进入卧室。向前走，让电视和斗柜位于你的左侧、床位于你的右侧。在窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Walk forward into the hallway. Proceed straight, passing a bathroom on your left. Continue straight, passing a brown pillar on your right as you enter an open living area. Turn right, keeping the main living room area with a sofa and TV on your left. Walk straight, passing a dining table with chairs on your right. Stop in front of the wall displaying two framed pictures, to the right of the white door.
instruction_zh: 向前走进走廊。继续直走，经过左侧的浴室。继续直走，在进入开放起居区时经过右侧的棕色柱子。右转，让带有沙发和电视的主要客厅区域位于你的左侧。直走，经过右侧配有椅子的餐桌。在挂着两幅装框图片的墙前停下，位置在白色门的右侧。

instruction_en: Walk straight down the hallway, keeping the green decorative panel on your right. As you approach the end of the hallway, with a round, brown wall decoration on your left, turn left to enter the doorway. Walk into the bathroom and stop in front of the shower enclosure, with the toilet and sink on your left and the window directly ahead of you.
instruction_zh: 沿走廊直走，让绿色装饰板位于你的右侧。接近走廊尽头时，左侧有一个棕色圆形墙饰，此时左转进入门口。走进浴室，在淋浴隔间前停下，马桶和洗手池位于你的左侧，窗户位于你的正前方。

instruction_en: Turn right into the main area, keeping the green wall art on your left and framed pictures on your right. Walk forward, passing a doorway to a room with a window on your left, and then a tall shelving unit also on your left. Turn left to face the bathroom entrance, with a coat rack on your right. Immediately turn left again, passing a large circular wall art on your left, and walk into the open living space. Proceed past the dining table and chairs on your right, then enter the kitchen. Stop in front of the kitchen counter, between the built-in ovens and the sink, directly facing the window.
instruction_zh: 右转进入主要区域，让绿色墙上艺术品位于你的左侧、装框图片位于你的右侧。向前走，先经过左侧通往带窗房间的门口，再经过左侧的高置物架。左转面向浴室入口，此时衣帽架位于你的右侧。立即再次左转，经过左侧的大型圆形墙上艺术品，走进开放起居空间。经过右侧的餐桌和椅子，然后进入厨房。在厨房台面前停下，位置在嵌入式烤箱和水槽之间，正对窗户。

instruction_en: Walk forward, passing the white wall on your left and a green decorative panel on your right. Turn right into the open area, with framed pictures on your right wall. Turn left to enter the narrow hallway with a wooden floor. Walk straight down the hallway, entering the bedroom directly ahead. Stop in front of the bed, with the bed on your left and a TV stand on your right.
instruction_zh: 向前走，经过左侧的白墙和右侧的绿色装饰板。右转进入开放区域，右侧墙上有装框图片。左转进入铺木地板的狭窄走廊。沿走廊直走，进入正前方的卧室。在床前停下，床位于你的左侧，电视柜位于你的右侧。

instruction_en: Turn right into the hallway, with a green framed artwork on your left and a wall displaying four framed artworks on your right. Walk straight through this hallway, passing a tall potted plant on your left and an open kitchen on your right. Go through the doorway straight ahead to enter the bedroom. Walk towards the bed on your left, and stop next to the bedside table on the right side of the bed.
instruction_zh: 右转进入走廊，左侧有一幅装框的绿色艺术品，右侧的墙上挂着四幅装框艺术品。直穿这条走廊，经过左侧的高盆栽和右侧的开放式厨房。穿过正前方的门口进入卧室。朝左侧的床走去，在床右侧的床头柜旁停下。

instruction_en: Go through the doorway and enter the room, keeping the wall with four framed artworks on your right. Walk forward, passing a tall potted plant on your right, then turn right into the dining area. Proceed forward, keeping the dining table on your left and a large window with bamboo blinds on your right, and stop in front of the window.
instruction_zh: 穿过门口进入房间，让挂着四幅装框艺术品的墙位于你的右侧。向前走，经过右侧的高盆栽，然后右转进入餐厅区域。继续向前，让餐桌位于你的左侧、带竹百叶帘的大窗户位于你的右侧，在窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Walk forward through the doorway into the main room, passing a low wooden bench on your right. Turn left, keeping the large painting and console table with two tall plants on your right. Enter the hallway, walking straight ahead past a dining room on your left, then turn right to enter a small room. Stop in front of the window.
instruction_zh: 向前穿过门口进入主房间，经过右侧的矮木凳。左转，让大幅画作以及摆着两株高植物的边柜位于你的右侧。进入走廊，向前直走，经过左侧的餐厅，然后右转进入一个小房间。在窗户前停下。

instruction_en: Turn right to enter the room with wooden flooring, passing a decorative stand on your left and a series of wooden wardrobes on your right. Walk straight ahead through this room towards the open doorway in front of you. Go through the doorway into the tiled hallway. On your right is a wall with a tall green decoration, and on your left is a smaller doorway leading to a room with a window. Continue walking straight down the hallway, passing a round wooden art piece on the wall to your right. Enter the open living and dining area, and stop with the dining table and kitchen on your left.
instruction_zh: 右转进入铺木地板的房间，经过左侧的装饰架和右侧的一排木衣柜。向前直穿这个房间，朝前方敞开的门口走去。穿过门口进入铺瓷砖的走廊。右侧墙上有一个高大的绿色装饰，左侧有一个较小的门口，通往带窗户的房间。继续沿走廊直走，经过右侧墙上的圆形木质艺术品。进入开放的客厅和餐厅区域，停下时让餐桌和厨房位于你的左侧。

instruction_en: Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your left and a bedroom also on your left. Continue past the kitchen and dining table on your right, then enter the living room straight ahead. Stop in front of the coffee table, with the sectional sofa on your left and the television on your right.
instruction_zh: 右转进入走廊。沿走廊直走，经过左侧的浴室，以及同样位于左侧的卧室。继续经过右侧的厨房和餐桌，然后进入正前方的客厅。在茶几前停下，组合沙发位于你的左侧，电视位于你的右侧。

instruction_en: From the hallway, turn left into the dining area. Walk straight, passing the dining table on your right. Continue into the kitchen and stop in front of the counter with the sink.
instruction_zh: 从走廊左转进入餐厅区域。直走，经过右侧的餐桌。继续进入厨房，在带水槽的台面前停下。

instruction_en: Walk forward past the bookshelves on your right. Turn left to enter the first doorway, with a painting on the wall to your right. Proceed straight through this doorway and continue straight through the next doorway immediately ahead. After passing the second doorway, turn left. Walk forward into the open room, keeping the dining table and chairs on your right and the living room area with sofas and a TV on your left. Turn slightly left and stop in front of the large window, with the television on your right and a sofa on your left.
instruction_zh: 向前走，经过右侧的书架。左转进入第一个门口，右侧墙上有一幅画。直走穿过这个门口，继续直走穿过紧接着位于前方的下一个门口。穿过第二个门口后左转。向前走进开放房间，让餐桌和椅子位于你的右侧、带沙发和电视的客厅区域位于你的左侧。稍向左转，在大窗户前停下，电视位于你的右侧，沙发位于你的左侧。

instruction_en: Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a doorway to a bathroom on your left and a doorway to a room with white folding doors straight ahead. Continue straight, passing a doorway to a library on your left and a doorway to a bedroom on your right. Proceed into the open living area, with a living room on your left and a dining table on your right. Walk further into the living room, keeping the TV wall on your right and the sofas and coffee table on your left. Stop in front of the large window, with the main sofa to your left.
instruction_zh: 右转进入走廊。沿走廊直走，经过左侧通往浴室的门口，以及正前方通往带白色折叠门房间的门口。继续直走，经过左侧通往书房的门口和右侧通往卧室的门口。走进开放起居区，客厅位于你的左侧，餐桌位于你的右侧。继续向客厅里面走，让电视墙位于你的右侧、沙发和茶几位于你的左侧。在大窗户前停下，主沙发位于你的左侧。

instruction_en: Turn left from your current position to face a hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom doorway on your left. Go through the doorway at the end of the hallway to enter a large open room. Walk straight through this room, keeping the dining table on your right, and continue past a living room area also on your right. Enter the hallway ahead of you. Walk straight down this hallway, passing an open doorway on your left. At the end of the hallway, turn right, then walk straight past the bathroom on your left. Enter the bedroom ahead, and stop in front of the bed.
instruction_zh: 从当前位置左转，面向一条走廊。沿走廊直走，经过左侧的浴室门口。穿过走廊尽头的门口，进入一个大型开放房间。直穿这个房间，让餐桌位于你的右侧，并继续经过同样位于右侧的客厅区域。进入前方的走廊。沿这条走廊直走，经过左侧敞开的门口。在走廊尽头右转，然后直走，经过左侧的浴室。进入前方的卧室，在床前停下。

instruction_en: Turn left from your current position to face a hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom doorway on your left. Go through the doorway at the end of the hallway to enter a large open room. Walk straight through this room, keeping the dining table on your right, and continue past a living room area also on your right. Enter the hallway ahead of you. Walk straight down this hallway, passing an open doorway on your left. At the end of the hallway, turn right, then walk straight past the bathroom on your left. Enter the bedroom ahead, and stop in front of the bed.
instruction_zh: 从当前位置左转，面向一条走廊。沿走廊直走，经过左侧的浴室门口。穿过走廊尽头的门口，进入一个大型开放房间。直穿这个房间，让餐桌位于你的右侧，并继续经过同样位于右侧的客厅区域。进入前方的走廊。沿这条走廊直走，经过左侧敞开的门口。在走廊尽头右转，然后直走，经过左侧的浴室。进入前方的卧室，在床前停下。

instruction_en: Walk straight through the tiled corridor, keeping the large windows and the view of the lake on your right. Turn left to enter the living room. Continue walking forward into the living room, passing the L-shaped sofa and coffee table on your right and a TV on your left. Stop in front of the main sofa with the decorative wooden wall panel behind it.
instruction_zh: 直走穿过铺瓷砖的走廊，让大窗户和窗外的湖景位于你的右侧。左转进入客厅。继续向前走进客厅，经过右侧的L形沙发和茶几，以及左侧的电视。在主沙发前停下，沙发后方是装饰性木质墙板。
